dantian.name: the Dantian
dantian.gloss: the elixir field: where a cultivator keeps what they have refined; your own Lachryma, a lake

terraces.name: the Herb Terraces
terraces.gloss: the beds, stepped round a small world

athanor.name: the Athanor
athanor.gloss: the alchemist's furnace, kept at one slow heat (al-tannur, the oven): the press and the firing

pavilions.name: the Pavilions of Echoes
pavilions.gloss: where echoes of the encounters you mastered keep working

mulberryGrove.name: the Mulberry Grove
mulberryGrove.gloss: the spirits' home; the cocoon tree is a mulberry, as silk's is

chimney.name: the Chimney
chimney.gloss: a kiln's chimney, where the Heavenly Kiln draws; the needle of rock it stands on
